title: The unsent one
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Wood writes a postcard. The back is shown for once: the bay side. The writing side goes into the box, not the mailbox. Eight left. The box has a postcard in it now, addressed, unsent.

panels.composition: The desk. WOOD writing on a postcard's back, fast, the pen pressing. BARNABY watching the pen.

image.prompt: a young man writing fast on the back of a postcard at a desk while a small dog watches the pen, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The card, turned: the bay, faded blue. The other side is never shown.

image.prompt: close on the front of a faded blue postcard of a small bay held in a young man's hand, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The box, opened an inch. The postcard going in, writing down, on top of page one.

image.prompt: close on a postcard being slipped into a cardboard box on top of a stack of pages, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The tape going back on. Eight postcards in the drawer. The box, heavier by nothing.

image.prompt: a young man pressing tape back onto a cardboard box's flaps at a desk, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: Written, addressed, unsent, boxed. Eight left.
